title: Matrix Block Sum
description: Given an m x n matrix mat and an integer k, return a matrix answer where each answer[i][j] is the sum of all elements mat[r][c] such that i - k <= r <= i + k and j - k <= c <= j + k.
pseudocode:
1. Build prefix sum matrix P of size (m+1)x(n+1)
2. For each cell (r, c) in mat:
3.   r1 = max(0, r-k), c1 = max(0, c-k)
4.   r2 = min(m-1, r+k), c2 = min(n-1, c+k)
5.   ans[r][c] = P[r2+1][c2+1] - P[r1][c2+1] - P[r2+1][c1] + P[r1][c1]

steps.note: Initialize 3x3 prefix sum matrix for 2x2 input.
Calculating answer for cell (0,0) with k=1.
Apply inclusion-exclusion: ans[0][0] = P[2][2] - P[0][2] - P[2][0] + P[0][0] = 10.
